title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1459: Battle (3)

section.p: Yang Hu was growing more and more alarmed. He attacked with all his strength and struck Zhankui’s arm with his sword. The arm was shattered, but it regrew instantly. However, that was enough to cause him to go pale. Before he could do anything else, a punch arrived and struck his chest.
Yang Hu shouted with great urgency, “Princes, kill Zhankui’s tri-life body! Do it! Now!”
Xuan Wuji and the others were only Mountainseas, but they could prove very helpful when it mattered.

At that, Xuan Wuji and the others gnashed their teeth and utilized their trump cards. Some used the blood essence of ninth-stage Sunmoons, some used heaven weapons, and some used talismans. Their auras rose sharply.
For a moment, Su Yu became the weakest person in the hall. The eight geniuses knew that it was time for them to get serious. They all charged toward Zhankui’s past body unhesitatingly.
Zhankui hurriedly shouted, “Prince, deal with your remaining opponents and help me!”

He was already facing three ninth-stage Sunmoons with his past body. The inclusion of eight combatants as strong as high-stage Sunmoons would put his past body in danger. Generally, the past body would be weaker than the present body. The past body of a Pseudo Invincible would not be stronger than a peak ninth-stage Sunmoon.

After all, that was the highest height a Pseudo Invincible could reach in the past. This was enough to handle three ninth-stage Sunmoons, but facing eight more was not something his past body could handle. Perhaps only the past body of an Invincible could do something like this.

At the same time, Su Yu received a voice transmission from Mo Duona, “After losing his past body, Zhankui will grow weaker. I will keep Yang Hu occupied for a split second. Take that opportunity to kill everyone here.”

He was not discussing a plan. He was laying out the plan. Or to be precise, his plan. Su Yu’s jaw dropped. Holy shit! He had the urge to curse. Even without his past body, Zhankui would still be a peak ninth-stage Sunmoon. Furthermore, there were other ninth-stage Sunmoons to deal with it. Su Yu couldn’t understand why Mo Duona was expecting him to take on all of them.
Just how much did Mo Duona overestimate him? Why shouldn’t he wait around for them to kill each other?

Mo Duona sent another voice transmission, “Delaying this might cause further complications. How much time do you think we have? I have yet to truly kill anyone. The moment someone dies, powerful death spirits will appear. You will need a lot of ancient city medallions to send these death spirits away. More than you can afford. The Invincibles might also return soon. We are running out of time.”

Su Yu was feeling quite gloomy. Mo Duona was running out of time. Not him. After thinking about it for a bit, he exhaled. If Mo Duona could keep the Pseudo Invincible busy, he could handle the ninth-stage Sunmoons. It would be extremely difficult. But it would also be…very exciting.

Su Yu couldn’t remember the last time he had to fight for his life. Could Mo Duona really handle a Pseudo Invincible? Yang Hu wouldn’t be an easy opponent. At the moment, Su Yu was standing at the corner all by himself. Everyone had neglected him since he was too weak.
With the inclusion of eight young geniuses, Zhankui was growing desperate. He roared, “Prince, help me!”
Mo Duona roared and sent his spear sweeping out, sending the two ninth-stage Sunmoons flying away. Then, he shot toward Zhankui’s past body.
Yang Hu roared, “Stop him! Kill Zhankui’s past body!”
Taihe and the other Sunmoon charged forward again and fought bitterly to keep Mo Duona busy. However, Mo Duona was able to send the two flying again before heading toward Zhankui.
Seeing that Mo Duona was slowly approaching him, Zhankui exhaled in relief. That was scary. How fortunate. Fortunately, the prince was powerful enough to charge through these people.
Before long, Mo Duona arrived. Xuan Wuji and the others felt very helpless as there was nothing they could do about it.
While gasping for breath, Zhankui said, “Fortunately, you’re here…”
This was too dangerous. His past body was filled with wounds. He wouldn’t be able to last long without Mo Duona’s assistance. How fortunate. Once again, he rejoiced at Mo Duona’s incredible prowess.
First, Mo Duona looked at Zhankui and the others coldly. Then, he grinned, “You…are too weak.”
Everyone frowned.
Zhankui did not mind those words. He was taking the chance to recover. Suddenly, Mo Duona looked at him and said, “Lord Zhankui, watch out.”
“I will—”
He widened his eyes and stared at Mo Duona blankly. He was not the only person with this reaction. Everyone was stunned. Su Yu was the sole exception.
With the spear in Zhankui’s heart, Mo Duona said indifferently, “I told you to watch out.”

Then, he released a burst of source qi and blew Zhankui apart. Pieces of flesh flew everywhere. Amid the rain of blood, a piece of plank dropped to the ground. Zhankui had never imagined something like this happening.

They were supposed to be on the same side. How would killing him benefit Mo Duona? Was Mo Duona trying to die with him? Instantly, his present body weakened. Yang Hu did not take the chance to finish him off. After all, Yang Hu was staring at Mo Duona with disbelief as well.
Xuan Wuji and Dao Cheng were stunned as well. What was wrong with Mo Duona? He killed Zhankui’s past body. Was he trying to die?
Zhankui’s furious voice rang out from above, “Mo Duona!”
He was furious.
He was losing his mind. How could Mo Duona kill his past body?

Xuan Wuji and the others laughed. How interesting. They were fighting among themselves. At this point, Zhankui would most certainly turn around to kill Mo Duona. Killing his past body was the same as severing his path of cultivation.
Mo Duona did not bother to spare Zhankui a look. Instead, he gazed at Yang Hu and said, “Let’s spend some time together.”

Yang Hu laughed. He was certain that Mo Duona had gone mad. Instead of focusing on him, Mo Duona should pay more attention to Zhankui. Just what was wrong with the devils? Had they all gone mad? He had killed the past body of his dao protector during a major battle with his enemies. Was this a joke?
Yang Hu said, “You should spend some time with Brother Zhankui instead. I’ll stay out of it.”
“Don’t worry. Someone else will handle him.”
One step at a time, Mo Duona stepped into the air. Above, Zhankui rushed down furiously.

Mo Duona completely ignored him. Right at that moment, someone appeared in the air with a flicker. With an indifferent and lazy voice, he manifested a book above his hand and blocked Zhankui’s punch. The punch pushed him several steps back, but he merely laughed and said, “Brother, calm down.”
Silence descended. Was there another expert in the hall? Wait…was that Ling Heng?
With the spear in hand, Mo Duona continued rising into the air. Without even looking back, he said, “He’s yours. Will you be fine? I can only keep this guy busy. I won’t be able to kill him alone.”

Su Yu sighed and said, “I must have gone crazy to work with you. I’m not a brute. I much prefer scheming everyone to death while watching from the sidelines. I don’t like fighting face-to-face. You…are too barbaric.”
“No, you will enjoy this.”
Mo Duona laughed and sent his spear stabbing toward Yang Hu. The attack was so powerful itthat instantly alarmed Yang Hu.
“You will discover that no scheme can provide the same sense of excitement a good battle can give you.”

“No, no, no. I don’t like it. You’re so unreliable.” Su Yu looked at the others and sighed, “A weakened Zhankui, six ninth-stage Sunmoons, and eight people with the combat strength of eighth-stage Sunmoons. Holy shit. This is good enough to kill even a Pseudo Invincible. Are you kidding me?”
“You’re here, right?”
“I guess so…”
Su Yu laughed. Yes. He was here.
This was…quite exciting. And nerve-racking.
Suddenly, Dao Cheng exclaimed with alarm, “Su Yu!”
“Yes, it’s me, Darling Dao Cheng.”

Su Yu returned to his original appearance while his clothes turned into white robes. With a book in hand, he flashed them a gentle smile and said, “Honored Princes, please allow Su Yu to send you to the afterlife.”
Silence descended. Su Yu!
Su Yu!
A realization dawned upon Dao Cheng. He roared in fury, “You…you were here all along! The two of you reached an agreement!”
“Exactly, my dear Dao Cheng.”

The book in his hand soared into the air and flipped open. One Sunmoon beast after another started emerging. While the beasts were emerging, he sighed and said, “I have a feeling my book will suffer some damage from this. My dear babies, please keep them busy for a bit. I’ll be back after dealing with Zhankui. Friends, have fun in my book.”
Instantly, thirteen experts were dragged into the book. The exertion caused Su Yu to pale slightly. He opened his yang acupoint. Death qi started spilling out of his body.

Finally, he consumed a drop of blood essence. His aura rose to the level of a peak ninth-stage Sunmoon. Facing the furious Zhankui, he smiled, “I…have never killed a Pseudo Invincible before. I guess you can’t be considered a proper Pseudo Invincible anymore. Oh well. I don’t mind it.”

Zhankui attacked without any hesitation. He was now certain that Mo Duona wanted to kill him. Mo Duona had reached an agreement with Su Yu. Inside the book, the immortal experts roared as they battled desperately against the many beasts in the book. They seemed capable of defeating each beast easily, but there were three hundred beasts in the book. It would take them some time to defeat all these beasts.
Su Yu did not waste any time and started his battle with Zhankui.
Divine Transformation.
Immortal Possession.
Devil’s Descend.
Strength character.
He utilized everything he could, instantly pushing his strength to an even higher level. All 360 of his characters shone brightly.
He threw a punch.
Two fists collided. Su Yu was sent three steps backward while Zhankui was sent two steps backward. He said, “You’re not enough. Die!”
As the two battled each other, the battle in the book continued.
Dao Cheng roared, “Kill these things and leave! We need to kill Su Yu!”
At the moment, he felt nothing but fear. Su Yu was here. That was not all. Su Yu was cooperating with Mo Duona.

Meanwhile, Mo Duona was still fighting Yang Hu. His strength had not stopped climbing, but he was still injured all over due to Yang Hu’s attacks. Nevertheless, he had a wide smile on his face. He was feeling joyous.
Even when it looked like Su Yu wasn’t Zhankui’s match, he laughed and said, “Su Yu, let’s compete, shall we?”
“Fuck that! You have the blood essence of the Devil Pseudo Emperor!”
“You have a lot of trump cards as well.”
“Hahaha! I guess you’re right!”

While roaring with laughter, Su Yu continued fighting Zhankui. He used his Time technique, Sky Sundering Saber, Heaven Suppressing Fist, and all sorts of techniques. Explosions were erupting all over the hall.

Due to the intense battle, more blood seeped out of Zhankui’s body. Meanwhile, Su Yu was also coughing blood from the attacks Zhankui landed on him. Nevertheless, his body was too strong for Zhankui to destroy so easily.
The intense battle continued.

Su Yu had way too many tricks up his sleeve. Everyone was alarmed by the sheer number of techniques and abilities he knew. Numerous blood essence abilities, numerous concealment techniques, and numerous elements were utilized smoothly by him.

The battle between Mo Duona and Yang Hu was akin to a collision between two beasts. Meanwhile, Su Yu’s battle with Zhankui was akin to an elegant dance. When Su Yu fought, it felt as though one could see the bright radiance of the various cultures on his body.
Countless techniques. Countless abilities. Countless cultivation methods. Countless characters.

Even Zhankui, who was slightly stronger than the current Su Yu, felt endlessly annoyed fighting him. This was an incredibly annoying opponent. However, he consoled himself that he only needed to last long enough. Xuan Wuji and the others were killing the beasts in the book rapidly. When they were done, Su Yu would die.
And after Su Yu’s defeat, Mo Duona would die as well. At worst, he would leave the devil race. This was not something he could tolerate. How could Mo Duona kill his past body?
Zhankui was too occupied by his battle with Su Yu to notice the sheer amount of blood that had seeped out of his body.
